_comment: COMPACT EQUIPMENT MODEL — the ONE documented exception to the entity-profile standard. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/equipment/equipment-model.md, _comment.
displayName: Equipment Model (compact, the role-based levels of ISA-95 Part 1 and ISA-88 — the documented exception)
attributeConvention: each level: <node>_id (key) | <node>_code | name | <parent>_ref (FK -> parent.<parent>_id, realises PART_OF)

foBinding.note: An order, segment or tool binds to the WORK UNIT of its branch (ISA-95 Part 1); which branch a work center uses is said by the plant's instances (equipmentLevel), never by the standard or the site — one site can run a batch area and a discrete line side by side (2026-10-29).

hierarchy.note: Work center of discrete production (Part 1 role-based hierarchy); the line of the UNS path.
Work unit of discrete production: the OT-relevant 'machine' level of a discrete plant; orders & segments bind here (core 6.0.0, audit H1).
Work center of batch production (ISA-88 / Part 1).
Work unit of batch production: the machine/process-stage level of a batch plant.
Work center of continuous production (Part 1); no work unit is assumed without the norm text.
The generic work center (Part 2 EquipmentLevel WorkCenter).
The generic work unit (Part 2 EquipmentLevel WorkUnit).
Below a work unit (ISA-88 names the Unit).
